name: iconic-agent-marketplace
description: Inspect live ICONIC agent services, evaluate MCP tool-selection readiness, and safely reconcile fictional or authorized public inventory data.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate MCP tools and reconcile data.
interface.longDescription: Explore ICONIC's agent-facing services. Inspect available offers and pricing, compare fictional inventories and run bounded public-data previews. The MCP Selection Test is a separate paid service. Payment requires explicit buyer authorization; inspecting or preparing a quote does not charge anyone.
defaultPrompt: Compare two fictional inventory snapshots and tell me what changed without assuming missing items were sold.
What does ICONIC's MCP Selection Test measure, what does it cost, and can it be purchased now?
Show available ICONIC agent services and separate those currently purchasable from drafts.
